d:
Rapper & Music Producer Yo Yo Honey Singh joins us in the newsroom. Get ready for some real talk as he opens up about his feuds with Badshah and Raftaar, clears the air on the Shah Rukh Khan slap incident, and shares personal stories about his childhood, bullying, and his first encounter with music. From collaborating with AR Rahman to working with Bollywood superstars like Shah Rukh Khan and Akshay Kumar, Honey Singh spills the beans on everything. Don't miss this exclusive interview where he also discusses his battle with addiction and his comeback.
